en_title: It Looks Like GTA 6's Beer Brands Are About to Become Real
subtitle: 从游戏到酒杯
opus_summary: 三款《GTA》相关啤酒的标签已获美国监管机构批准，由佛罗里达州酒厂酿造。Rockstar似乎准备将游戏中的品牌带到现实，但具体销售时间与地点尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: It appears that Rockstar may be preparing to sell beer brands from GTA 6 in real life.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar似乎正准备在现实中销售《GTA6》里的啤酒品牌。

paragraphs.en: As spotted by iGrandTheftAuto , labels for three GTA-related beer brands have been approved by the US Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau. The labels include brands that have been featured in previous GTA titles, such as Patriot Beer and Pißwasser (commonly known as Pisswasser). There's also a new brand known as No Mames Vice City, which features a little dog wearing sunglasses and a Vice City chain on the label.
paragraphs.cn: iGrandTheftAuto发现，三款《GTA》相关啤酒品牌的标签已获美国酒精和烟草税收贸易局批准。其中包括曾在《GTA》系列前作中出现的Patriot Beer和Pißwasser（通常称为Pisswasser）。此外还有一个名为No Mames Vice City的新品牌，标签上画着一只戴墨镜、挂着Vice City项链的小狗。

paragraphs.en: These are being produced by a Florida brewery known as Tripping Animals Brewing. For alcohol afficianados, No Mames Vice City lager will have a 6% ABV, while the other two will be 4.2% ABV, which is identical to Bud Light's ABV. With all of that said, we have no idea exactly when or where these beverages will be sold.
paragraphs.cn: 这些啤酒由佛罗里达州一家名为Tripping Animals Brewing的酒厂酿造。爱喝酒的读者或许会关心：No Mames Vice City拉格啤酒的酒精度为6%，另外两款则为4.2%，与百威淡啤相同。不过，这些啤酒究竟何时、在哪里销售，我们仍一无所知。

paragraphs.en: They may be exclusive to bars in and around Miami, as Rockstar Games has completely taken over the city with GTA 6 ads . Citizens have spotted various in-universe ads for various GTA brands around the area, and there's also a giant Vice City blimp flying over Florida. The Miami Heat's arena has also been transformed ahead of an unprecedented Vice City-themed NBA game in November .
paragraphs.cn: 这些啤酒可能只在迈阿密及周边地区的酒吧销售，毕竟Rockstar已经用《GTA6》的广告覆盖了整座城市。当地居民在各处发现了《GTA》世界中多个品牌的广告，佛罗里达州上空还有一艘巨大的罪恶都市主题飞艇。迈阿密热火队的球馆也已换上新装，为11月一场前所未有的罪恶都市主题NBA比赛做准备。

paragraphs.en: It's possible some of these drinks could be sold online, but it may make more sense to keep it limited to special in-person activiations around the city. Either way, it shows that Rockstar has spared no expense when it comes to alerting the public of GTA 6's arrival. Rockstar has also begun advertising the game in Paris, New York City, Chicago, and Los Angeles. It's unclear if any other cities will get big advertising outside of posters and billboards, or if this is all exclusive to Miami itself.
paragraphs.cn: 其中一些啤酒有可能在线上销售，但只在迈阿密各处的特别线下活动中供应，或许更为合理。无论如何，这都表明Rockstar为了让公众知道《GTA6》即将到来，可谓不惜成本。Rockstar也已开始在巴黎、纽约、芝加哥和洛杉矶为这款游戏投放广告。目前尚不清楚，其他城市是否也会在海报和广告牌之外迎来大规模宣传活动，还是只有迈阿密才有这样的待遇。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5.
